quote.text: When a young man was boasting in the theater and saying, I am wise, for I have conversed with many wise men; Epictetus said, I also have conversed with many rich men, but I am not rich.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Teach your children that true wisdom lies in humility—not in boasting about associations, but in recognizing that life’s richest lessons come from inner reflection, not external accolades.
    • Model for your children that genuine learning involves being honest about what you know and what you still have to learn, encouraging a mindset that values substance over superficial prestige.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, remember that accumulating impressive connections is not the same as possessing wisdom; true leadership emerges from understanding one's limits and remaining open to continuous growth.
    • Lead by example—practice self-awareness and authenticity, valuing depth and genuine insight over empty status symbols, thus inspiring trust and respect among your team.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, focus on the true value and vision behind a product rather than relying solely on external accolades or the reputation of advisors; substance matters more than superficial endorsements.
    • Adopt a mindset of continuous improvement by critically assessing feedback and measuring success by how well your product truly serves its users, rather than by the prestige of those associated with it.
